note: Independent re-judgment against RFC 5575 Section 4 ('Whenever the corresponding application does not require Next-Hop information, this shall be encoded as a 0-octet length Next Hop in the MP_REACH_NLRI attribute and ignored on receipt.') after export-chain next-hop unification (cabc8c511e / c2d7117d05). Verified changes: TestFlowSpecForwardingOmitsNextHop (flowspec_forward_wire_test.go) migrated next-hop modes from PeerSettings.NextHopMode/NextHopAddress to flowForwardApplyNextHop (setExportNextHopUnchanged, setExportNextHopSelf, and attachExplicitNextHop for explicit4/explicit6), preserving all four FlowSpec families (IPv4/IPv6 flow and flow-vpn), all received next-hop shapes (empty, peer-address, ipv6), and exact zero-hop MP_REACH + traffic-rate action assertions. The other four tagged units (TestFlowSpecUpdateIgnoresConfiguredNextHop, TestRFC8955NextHopIgnoredForFlowSpec, TestFlowSpecOriginationOmitsConfiguredNextHop, TestFlowSpecRouteServerOmitsNextHop) remain intact and enforce both zero-length transmission and receipt ignoring across builder, origination, RIB validation, cached forwarding, and live route server. Superseded annotation (restated RFC8955-4-3/4-4) remains accurate.
